Transparent Engineering Disclosures (Phase 20 Fairness Audit — Table V, D9)

1. Graph RAM vs. SQ8 Buffer RAM
Graph-only v3-geom-M8 adds +32 B/node (+1.91%) = 0.143× ACORN-γ's level-0 graph RAM (+224 B/n). Full v3-full-guard-sq8 retains an auxiliary SQ8 buffer (+384 B/node = 200.8 MB) alongside FP32, totaling +416 B/node (+24.8%) (mode3_f32 avoids this copy at 0 extra vector RAM).
2. Python O(N) Mask Prep & End-to-End H1+H2
faiss-hnsw-M16's 0.95 ms includes ~0.823 ms of Python packbits + permutation (~0.13 ms pure C++ FAISS). Even adding full persistent PG17 SpiceDB live RPC (3.49 ms) to v3-full-guard-sq8 (0.11 ms → ~3.6 ms end-to-end), Prism stays 5.5×–41× faster than hnswlib/pgvector at S≤1%.
3. Cold-Start Paging & Unbounded Baselines
Un-warmed cpp-mode3-sq8 ran right after ~1 GB corpus allocation (0.17–0.20 ms cold vs. ~0.05 ms warm, identical kernel to v3-full-guard-sq8). At S=5%, hnswlib (99.2%) & pgvector (97.2%) retain +1.9–4.0 pts over v3-full-guard-sq8 (95.3%) at 8×–10× higher latency.
